headline: Senate passes historic slate of conservation bills while House stays dark; cloture votes on Insider Trading Act and Labor Secretary set for Wednesday

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate passed 14 bills Tuesday, including major conservation legislation designating wilderness areas and national parks across multiple states. Votes on two nominations and healthcare regulations failed along party lines, while the chamber advanced toward cloture votes on the Stop Insider Trading Act, the Ratepayer Protection Act, and Keith Sonderling's nomination for Labor Secretary, all scheduled for Wednesday.
